'''Hinto Salisburr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] weapons manufacturer living during the [[Galactic War]]. Officially a major [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] defense contractor, he also secretly sold military secrets to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
